upload.title: 여섯 시 사십 분 | 사직서를 지갑에 넣고 출근하는 아빠의 노래 #shorts
upload.description:
사직서를 지갑에 넣고 다니는 모든 아빠, 엄마에게.
매일 아침 바위를 밀어 올리는 시시포스처럼, 우리는 오늘도 출근합니다.

가사는 MIDLIFE COMMUTER가 직접 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.
당신의 출근길 이야기를 댓글로 들려주세요. 다음 노래가 됩니다.

#출근 #직장인 #아빠 #위로 #가장 #직장인노래 #MIDLIFECOMMUTER

shots.plate: the entrance hallway of a small Korean apartment before dawn, deep blue light through a small window, a shoe rack and a front door, quiet and still
shots.motion: the tired man lets out a slow sigh, his shoulders rise and fall, he glances at the front door, the small ceiling lamp glows softly

shots.plate: a dim apartment hallway before dawn lit by one small warm wall lamp, a coat hanger and a mirror, cozy but tired mood
shots.motion: the man looks down at the old wallet in his hands, gently touches a folded letter inside, then closes the wallet with a small sad smile

shots.plate: a cozy Korean apartment living room at dawn, soft warm lamp light, framed family photos and children's drawings on the wall, toys on the floor
shots.motion: the two children wave and giggle at their father, the man smiles back warmly and nods, warm lamp light

shots.plate: the elevator lobby of a Korean apartment building at dawn, steel elevator doors, cool blue morning light, clean tiled floor
shots.motion: the man walks forward through the lobby with his briefcase, the elevator doors slide open behind him, the grandmother neighbour nods to him
shots.extras: an elderly grandmother neighbour with a small shopping cart waiting at the side

shots.plate: a busy Seoul subway platform in the early morning, a big digital clock on the wall showing 6:40, blue morning light, platform screen doors
shots.motion: the man walks along the busy platform among the commuters, a subway train slides into the station behind the screen doors, people shift and wait
shots.extras: many sleepy commuters in winter coats standing in a line along the platform on both sides, a young woman with earphones, an old man with a cap

shots.plate: a long steep uphill street in a Korean city at sunrise, the road climbing high up a hill toward the sky, small shops and apartment blocks on both sides
shots.motion: the man walks slowly up the steep street away from the camera, a delivery scooter passes by, the morning light grows warmer
shots.extras: a delivery rider on a scooter and a street sweeper in an orange vest far up the hill

shots.plate: inside a Seoul subway train carriage in the morning, warm golden sunlight streaming through the windows, hand straps hanging, long seats on both sides
shots.motion: the subway car sways gently as it moves, sunlight flickers across the passengers, the man stands holding his briefcase and smiles softly to himself
shots.extras: passengers sitting on both long seats along the walls, a student dozing, a grandmother with a shopping bag, office workers standing farther back

shots.plate: a long outdoor stone staircase climbing up a hill in a quiet Korean neighbourhood at sunrise, small houses on both sides, a glowing golden sky at the top of the stairs
shots.motion: at the top of the stairs his wife and children wave to him happily, the man looks up at them and starts to climb, golden sunrise light

shots.plate: a wide Seoul crosswalk in the morning rush hour, tall office towers, golden morning light, zebra crossing stripes
shots.motion: the crowd crosses the zebra crossing around the man as he walks briskly forward, cars wait at the light, busy morning
shots.extras: a crowd of commuters crossing, a grandfather with a cane, a student with a backpack

shots.plate: a busy Seoul office building entrance in the morning, glass doors and warm sunlight, a few potted plants, hopeful start of the day
shots.motion: the young colleague greets the man with a cheerful bow, the man smiles and pats his shoulder, the glass doors open behind them

shots.plate: a city street at sunrise, the road leading toward a bright golden rising sun between office buildings, warm hopeful mood
shots.motion: the man walks away toward the bright rising sun down the street, people walk to work around him
shots.extras: people walking to work along the street
